name: oeis-mcp-server
description: Search the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS): identify sequences by terms, A-number, formulas, and cross-references.

interface.shortDescription: Look up and identify integer sequences in the OEIS.
interface.longDescription: Search the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences from your agent. Identify an unknown sequence from a list of observed terms, look up a sequence by A-number, and read its formulas, generating functions, code, and offsets. Follow cross-references to related sequences and transforms. Every record links back to its OEIS page.
